name: drut
description: Syntax highlighting and language support for Cube Voyager control-statement scripts (.s/.block), backed by the Drut language server.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A self-closing short-IF, distinguished from a block-style IF (spec.md FR-016).
A generic base type for a whole-statement span carrying only a modifier (e.g. unreachable) — this feature declares no general-syntax token types of its own.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A statement that can never execute because it follows a BREAK validly resolved as inside its enclosing loop (spec.md FR-017).

drut.format.casingControlWords.markdownDescription: Casing convention for control-word keywords (e.g. `IF`/`ENDIF`/`LOOP`). A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.casingPairKeywords.markdownDescription: Casing convention for pair keywords. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.casingDataReferences.markdownDescription: Casing convention for data-reference tokens (Matrix/Line/Node/Zone/Database abbreviations, output-record and link-endpoint tokens, and the two reserved loop-index identifiers). A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.casingFunctionCalls.markdownDescription: Casing convention for Cube Voyager built-in function names (e.g. `REPLACESTR`, `ROUND`, `TRIM`) when immediately followed by `(`. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.indentTopLevel.markdownDescription: Top-level (depth-0) indentation policy — `preserve` leaves it exactly as written; `auto` forces every top-level line to column 0. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.indentWidth.markdownDescription: Spaces per nesting level of block indentation. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.operatorSpacing.markdownDescription: Whitespace normalization around operators/commas/bracket-paren interiors — `preserve` leaves it exactly as written; `fixed` normalizes to one space each side of every recognized operator; `auto` does everything `fixed` does plus vertically aligning consecutive assignment statements' `=`. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.blankLines.markdownDescription: Whether/how excessive blank-line runs are contracted — `preserve` leaves every run exactly as written; `auto` contracts a run down to the applicable cap (see `drut.format.blankLinesTopCap`/`drut.format.blankLinesNestedCap`) only when it exceeds that cap. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.blankLinesTopCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines `auto` allows between top-level statements/blocks before contracting the run. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.blankLinesNestedCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines `auto` allows inside any block's own body, uniformly regardless of nesting depth, before contracting the run. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.highlight.controlWords.markdownDescription: Color for control-flow keywords (`IF`, `LOOP`, `RUN`, `ENDIF`, ...) — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `keyword.control.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.statementWords.markdownDescription: Color for general statement/procedure words (`PRINT`, `FILEI`, `FILEO`, `ARRAY`, ...) — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `support.function.statement.drut`). Independent of `drut.highlight.functionCalls`. Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.functionCalls.markdownDescription: Color for recognized Cube Voyager built-in function calls (`REPLACESTR(...)`, `ROUND(...)`, ...) — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `support.function.builtin.drut`). Independent of `drut.highlight.statementWords`. Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.pairKeywords.markdownDescription: Color for a `keyword=value` pair's keyword name — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `variable.parameter.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.values.markdownDescription: Color for a pair's bareword value (e.g. `PGM=MATRIX`'s `MATRIX`) — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `constant.other.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.numbers.markdownDescription: Color for numeric literals — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `constant.numeric.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.operators.markdownDescription: Color for operators (`=`, `+`, `-`, `<>`, ...) — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scope `keyword.operator.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.comments.markdownDescription: Color for `; ...` and `/* ... */` comments — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scopes `comment.line.semicolon.drut`/`comment.block.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.strings.markdownDescription: Color for quoted string literals — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep your color theme's own color for this category (scopes `string.quoted.single.drut`/`string.quoted.double.drut`). Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

drut.highlight.namedVariables.markdownDescription: Color for `@name@` substitution — a CSS color such as `#RRGGBB`. Leave unset to keep the extension's existing default (`#4EC9B0`), auto-applied per workspace since some color themes render this category invisibly otherwise. Unlike every other `drut.highlight.*` setting, this one is written into the current workspace's own settings (`.vscode/settings.json`), not your personal/global settings — required for this override to actually take effect. Personal setting only — there is no `drut.toml` equivalent.

scripts.test: ts-node test/grammar.test.ts && ts-node test/formatOnSave.test.ts && ts-node test/binaryBootstrap.test.ts && ts-node test/highlightCustomization.test.ts
